notes: Porsche reports deliveries and employees by its five sales regions; Germany is a region and a country, so it is stored as a country row (DE), once per metric. Only 'China incl. Hong Kong' carries a country list because the report names its members; 'North America excl. Mexico', 'Europe without Germany' and 'Overseas and Emerging Markets' (the remaining countries; renamed from 'rest of the world') are left null. Each region appears twice, once per metric, because deliveries and employees come from different passages. The employee table's column headers (Germany | Europe (without Germany) | North America excl. Mexico | China incl. Hong Kong | Overseas and emerging markets | Total) map to the values in order; the quote joins the table title and row with '…'. No per-country delivery figures (e.g. U.S.) appear in the report or the Jan 2025 deliveries release, and no U.S. state data. Documents are the English PDFs on newsroom.porsche.com (Porsche notes only the German version is legally binding). Bratislava, Osnabrück and Kulim are Volkswagen Group or third-party sites used by Porsche, not Porsche-owned plants.
